edges.reason: _msgSender returns msg.sender, propagating the untrusted caller identity into the contract.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of funds.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for allowance deduction.
setLP checks _msgSender() for the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
transfer branches on recipient==_lp and returns false without transferring.
transferFrom branches on recipient==_lp and silently returns false.
The privileged _lp state variable gates the transfer filter branches.
setLP writes the privileged _lp address.
transfer calls the internal _transfer to move balances.
transferFrom calls the internal _transfer to move balances.
_transfer computes the burn amount with mul/div before deducting.
BURN_RATE feeds the burn amount computation.
PERCENTS_DIVIDER is the divisor of the burn amount computation.
_transfer subtracts remainingAmount from the sender balance.
_transfer updates _balances for sender and recipient.
_burn reduces the account balance in _balances.
_mint increases the account balance in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
transferFrom subtracts amount from the nested allowance mapping.
_allowances is read and rewritten during the allowance subtraction.
burnFrom subtracts amount from the caller allowance.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
grantRole verifies adminRole through _roles before granting.
revokeRole verifies adminRole through _roles before revoking.
grantRole authorization requires _msgSender() to hold the admin role.
revokeRole authorization requires _msgSender() to hold the admin role.
snapshot increments _currentSnapshotId through the Counters library.
Constructor mints initial supply to msg.sender and grants it all roles.
Constructor grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and SNAPSHOT_ROLE via _setupRole/grant path.
recipient parameter drives the _lp equality check in transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
sender parameter is used as the balance source in transferFrom.
spender parameter is written into the allowance mapping by _approve.
value parameter feeds the burn and balance arithmetic inside _transfer.
remainingAmount is derived and then subtracted from the sender balance.
burnAmount is the output of the burn calculation operation.
decreasedAllowance is computed inside burnFrom from the allowance subtraction.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is a local parameter of transfer, merge into the transfer function node.
amount is a local parameter of transfer, merge into the transfer function node.
sender is a local parameter of transferFrom, merge into the transferFrom function node.
spender is a local parameter consumed by _approve, merge into the _approve function node.
value is the internal transfer amount, merge into the _transfer function node.
remainingAmount is a temporary derived inside _transfer, merge into the _transfer function node.
burnAmount is the result of the burn_rate_calc unsafe operation, merge into it.
decreasedAllowance is a temporary computed inside burnFrom, merge into the burnFrom function node.
